entries.name: Albert Skinner

expected.charges: Conspiracy to file false Taft-Hartley non-Communist affidavits
expected.convicted: Yes — 1959 conviction reversed; convicted again September 20, 1963
expected.sentence: Three years in federal prison and a $2,000 fine imposed in November 1963. He remained free on appeal bond and did not serve the prison sentence.

entries.rationale: U.S. Attorneys Bulletin March 6, 1964, printed p125 / physical p22 explicitly dates November 7, 1963 sentences for the six retrial defendants. Scan visually verified because OCR omits the day. Supreme Court Dennis opinion identifies these five plus Maurice Travis. Refine sentencing month only; no incarceration or release date inferred.
